summary: The BGP Monitoring Protocol (BMP) provides access to routing information bases. This document updates BMP (RFC 7854) by adding access to the Local RIB (Loc-RIB), the table of routes a BGP speaker has selected through its Decision Process, as defined in RFC 4271.

eli5.summary: A router keeps a list of its chosen best routes. This document lets monitoring tools peek at that list too, not just the routes the router heard from others.

questions: how to monitor bgp local rib
